flags: WATERFRONT (upgrade candidate, reviewer decides): stored riverview. Lower Loop east-tip sites 12 (44.04171,-99.43538; pull-through, 71 ft) and 22A (44.04145,-99.43548; back-in, 54 ft), both reservable nightly on recreation.gov, sit ~40 m from the Missouri's edge across open grass, the loop road and the riprap bank (Esri 0.29 m/px). The river is far wider than 30 m. Only these two sites (11 marginal, under trees); sites 1-10 are behind a tree/marsh belt, the Upper Loop ~110 m from the tailrace. Per the 'a few clear sites' rule this would be riverfront with a caveat naming 12 and 22A; I'm leaving the stored riverview for the reviewer because the margin is only two sites. Not a lake value: the campground is below the dam (the Overview's 'shore of Lake Francis Case' is the river reach under the dam).

NAME/NOTE: stored name 'Left Tailrace Campground (Big Bend Dam, Lake Sharpe)' and the old note ('at the head of Lake Sharpe') put it on Lake Sharpe; recreation.gov says it is BELOW Big Bend Dam on the Missouri (Lake Francis Case reach). Suggest name 'Left Tailrace Campground (Big Bend Dam)'.

SEASON (not written): recreation.gov sells nights only May 1-Sept 30 (2026 and 2027 Peak Season; no inventory Oct-Apr). Whether the campground stays open off-season without reservations is unknown - the USACE Lake Sharpe page (403, Akamai) is the source; left absent.
